sn12.34:1.2: Satta sattari vo bhikkhave ñāṇavatthūni desissāmi ||
sn12.34:2.4: atītam pi addhānam jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti ñānaṃ || asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ || anāgatam pi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ || asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.34:2.6: Yam pissa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tam pi khayadhammam vayadhammam virāgadhammam nirodhamman ti ñāṇaṃ || 4
sn12.34:3.10: Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ || asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.34:3.11: atītam pi addhānam avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ || asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.34:3.12: anāgatam pi addhānam avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ || asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārā ti ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.34:3.13: Yam pissa tam dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tam pi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammanti ñāṇaṃ || || 14
